title: Adansefo a Wogyina Pii
intro: Susuw bere bi a wɔde ogya sɔɔ gyidi hwɛe, na gyidi a enhinhim bɛyɛɛ asɔretia a etwa to no ho hwɛ. Wɔde ahyɛ wo nsa sɛ wobɛda kuw bi a wɔaka wɔn asɛm wɔ Kur’aan mu, gyidi a emu dɔ ho asɛm a ɛko tia atirimɔdensɛm a ɛboro so ho asɛm. Bue nsɛnkyerɛnne no mu na woahu nnipa ko a na saa akra yi yɛ, ne tebea soronko a wohyiae.
clues: Yegyinaa pintinn wɔ yɛn gyidi mu, ɛmfa ho nhyɛso kɛse a yɛde bɛpow yɛn gyidi no.
Sodifo bi a ɔwɔ tumi a ɔhwehwɛɛ sɛ obedum onyame biako som kanea no de n’ani sii yɛn so.
Yehuu nsɛnkyerɛnne akɛse ne anwonwade ahorow, nanso yɛn nhyɛsofo no kɔɔ so yɛɛ anibiannaso.
Yegyinaa ɔtaa kwan a ɛyɛ hu a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛbɔ afoforo hu ma wɔabrɛ wɔn ho ase no ano.
Wɔtoo yɛn guu ogyaframa a ɛredɛw mu, nanso yɛn pintinnyɛ no maa yenyaa gyinabea a ɛkorɔn wɔ Allah nkyɛn.
Wɔaka yɛn asɛm no wɔ Surah bi a wɔde ɔsoro nsoromma akuw din ato so mu, na ɛbɔ wɔn a wɔtaa agyidifo no nkrabea ho kɔkɔ.

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
